purpose: Longitudinal, human-in-the-loop UX research benchmark that complements deterministic Istara scenario, eval, security, and long-horizon benchmark suites.
non_duplication_policy: Do not re-run or re-implement classical deterministic studies from tests/simulation, tests/evals, tests/benchmarks, or scripts/security_benchmark.py inside this benchmark. Treat those suites as baseline evidence. This benchmark should test realistic cross-feature user behavior, longitudinal usefulness, integration ergonomics, compute donation, and human review quality.

default_run_contract.storage_guardrail: Colima autostart uses --root-disk 10 --disk 10 and records actual/apparent storage snapshots with 10GB actual and 20GB apparent budgets.
default_run_contract.client_sandbox_policy: Server sandboxing and client/donor sandboxing are independent. External Istara servers can receive donated compute from disposable benchmark containers.
default_run_contract.multi_donor_policy: Default comparison uses one Gemma donor. Multi-donor runs require per-donor pre-provisioned OpenAI-compatible/LM Studio endpoints and connection strings; missing Qwen endpoints are blockers, not downloads.
default_run_contract.opt_out: Set ISTARA_BENCHMARK_REQUIRE_COMPUTE_DONATION=0 and ISTARA_BENCHMARK_REQUIRE_LIVE_CHAT=0 only for offline harness debugging, not comparison runs.

live_model_profile.provider_contract: one configured OpenAI-compatible/LM Studio target loaded from gitignored env or Keychain
live_model_profile.multi_donor_exception: Only explicit multi-donor benchmark runs may use additional already-provisioned per-donor endpoints such as Qwen3.5-4B. The benchmark must not download missing models.

companion_suites.role: Deterministic feature and menu scenario coverage.
companion_suites.relationship: Reference for coverage mapping; do not duplicate scenario assertions.

companion_suites.role: Tracked AI eval definitions and live-LLM quality probes.
companion_suites.relationship: Reference for model-serving and quality baselines; this benchmark adds realistic product workflow evidence.
Reference for agent orchestration baseline; this benchmark adds UI, onboarding, integrations, and human task review.
Run as a separate gate for auth, connection-string, compute, MCP, webhook, and LLM-provider changes.

agentic_eval_focus.area: live chat and donated compute routing
agentic_eval_focus.benchmark_role: Prove that realistic chat turns return non-empty output through the donated compute path before scoring researcher usefulness.

agentic_eval_focus.area: tool calling and ReAct skill use
agentic_eval_focus.benchmark_role: Ask natural researcher requests that require tool/skill attempts and record whether Istara exposes useful call evidence.

agentic_eval_focus.baseline: tests/evals plus Ragas/TruLens-inspired metrics in testing/AI_EVALS_STRATEGY.md
agentic_eval_focus.benchmark_role: Check retrieved-source usefulness, citations, contradictions, uploaded-corpus grounding, and context-window stress behavior.
Ask whether stored project memory improves current synthesis without overriding fresh evidence.
Use the safest product path to propose bounded benchmark/process improvements and review their quality.
Record compute-health and ensemble/MoA readiness evidence; multi-donor runs wait for the requested relay-node count and preserve route evidence before scoring ensemble readiness.

future_multi_donor_profiles.notes: Uses the existing configured live test target. Sensitive host/token values stay outside committed files.

Activated by ISTARA_BENCHMARK_DONOR_COUNT=2 plus a provisioned endpoint such as ISTARA_BENCHMARK_DONOR_2_LLM_HOST or ISTARA_BENCHMARK_QWEN_LLM_HOST. Do not download or autoload this model until explicitly provisioned by the user.

industry_alignment.applied_as: Explicit test objective, reusable test design, execution logs, incident evidence, and repeatable reporting.
Score dimensions cover functional suitability, usability, reliability, performance, security-sensitive integration behavior, and maintainability of the benchmark evidence.
Scenario uses a realistic UX researcher persona, context of use, evidence review, and human decision points.

industry_alignment.reference: ISTQB exploratory and session-based testing practice
industry_alignment.applied_as: Long-form chartered session with natural steering, timestamped notes, observed failures, and product-risk classification.

industry_alignment.reference: AI evaluation and red-team evidence practice
industry_alignment.applied_as: Preserves prompts, responses, model-routing evidence, tool behavior, integration blockers, and comparison-ready history without storing private endpoints or tokens.
